claims: Luke Murray is the son of actor Bill Murray.
Luke Murray was hired as the new head coach for the Boston College men's basketball team in March 2026.
Luke Murray was an assistant coach and offensive coordinator at UConn.
Luke Murray helped UConn win back-to-back national championships in 2023 and 2024.
Luke Murray served as an assistant coach at UConn, Louisville, Xavier, Rhode Island, Towson, Arizona, and Wagner.
Luke Murray is one of Bill Murray's six sons.
Bill Murray is a frequent, supportive presence at Luke Murray's games.
